description: parse_command handles IHAVE, XCID, XVERIFY by storing rest.to_string() directly with no Message-ID format validation. The CLAUDE.md security rule states 'message_id from the NNTP wire is untrusted; validate format before using as a map key or log entry.' XCID and XVERIFY pass the raw string to msgid_map.lookup_by_msgid() which uses it as a SQL bind parameter (safe from injection) but an oversized or malformed message_id (e.g. 64 KB) will allocate a large String and be stored in the session state or passed directly to SQLite. Should call is_valid_message_id() before passing to storage.
title: Message-ID not validated on IHAVE/XCID/XVERIFY wire input
